question1Label: Are you basically satisfied with your life?
question2Label: Have you dropped many of your activities and interests?
question3Label: Do you feel that your life is empty?
question5Label: Are you in good spirits most of the time?
question6Label: Are you afraid that something bad is going to happen to you?
question7Label: Do you feel happy most of the time?
question9Label: Do you prefer to stay at home, rather than going out and doing things?
question10Label: Do you feel that you have more problems with memory than most?
question11Label: Do you think it is wonderful to be alive now?
question12Label: Do you feel worthless the way you are now?
question13Label: Do you feel full of energy?
question14Label: Do you feel that your situation is hopeless?
question15Label: Do you think that most people are better off than you are?
questionnaireDescription: Apply the questionnaire by computing the answers that indicate how the person has been feeling in the last week.
questionnaireAnswersDescription: Mark YES or NO. Each answer should be scored according to the indicator next to it. The final result will be the sum of the 15 answers.
